name: Pro Planet P8
summary: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P8 RO Water Purifier features advanced 8-stage RO + Silver Shield Technology (SCMT) for 100% RO purified, baby-safe water .
intro: Powered by advanced RO + Silver Shield Technology (SCMT), the A. O. Smith ProPlanet P8 delivers 100% RO purified, baby-safe water through its 8-stage purification system. Enjoy the convenience of ambient, warm (45°C), and hot (80°C) water at the touch of a button. Featuring a 6.5L anti-bacterial storage tank, up to 60% water recovery, a digital display, the P8 is designed for safe, smart, and sustainable hydration. Suitable for borewell, tanker, and mixed water sources with both wall-mount and tabletop installation.
features: Baby-Safe Water, Digital Display, High Water Saving (5-Star Rated), Anti-Bacterial Tank, Hot Water, Lifetime Warranty on Tank
